summary: Describes how to carry G.722.1 audio bitstreams in RTP packets, including the details needed for MIME and SDP. It is on the standards track. It was replaced by RFC 5577.

eli5.summary: To send voice over the Internet in small packages, the sender and receiver need to agree on how to pack it. This explains it for one voice format. A newer document later replaced it.

questions: how to send g.722.1 audio over rtp
